mode: Python library from a git checkout, local decision profile, no API key, run through a JSON-lines bridge in Jev-Mem's own Python
door: QueryEngine.query(question, top_k=5): the ranked evidence block, each item with its date; no answer model
results: top_k 5 (the value JevMemSystem.query uses), no cut
model: Laya (convaiinnovations/laya), local System-One model: memory decisions (typing, relations, routing, stopping); no answer model
storage: Jev-Mem's own store on disk: graph, vectors and keyword index (format not stated)
not_default: decision profile config/laya_mem.json (local Laya, no key) instead of the default profile, which calls TypeSafe's Jev API; OPENAI_API_KEY removed in the bridge so no answer model runs (the benchmark measures what reaches the model)
